Agent-written regular-word evaluation and leading-unit clause; read online; WANTED: archived source in literature/. No Stacks tag states this coherent comparison.

proof.text: Write $\mathsf{BM}$ for the planar operad with colours $v,m,t$ and unique operations $v^r\to v$, $t^s\to t$, $v^rmt^s\to m$ ($r,s\geq0$). The coherent left action of $\mathcal V$ on $\mathcal M$ is a coherent functor on $N(\mathsf{BM}^\otimes)$ whose value at a list is the product of the colour fibres $\mathcal V,\mathcal M,*$ and whose value at a block operation is the iterated tensor/action, with the assumed associativity and unit coherences as its higher simplices. Apply [lem-coef-cocartesian-straightening] (in an enlarged universe) to obtain the action-valued target $q:\mathcal E^\otimes\to N(\mathsf{BM}^\otimes)$: a cocartesian fibration whose fibre over a list is that product and whose cocartesian transport along an operator is the corresponding block tensor/action functor. By the mapping-space pullback square of that node, maps over an operator $\alpha$ from $x$ to $y$ are maps $\alpha_!x\to y$ in a product fibre, hence a product over the output blocks; with the product decompositions of [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category] this makes $\mathcal E^\otimes$ (over $N(\Delta^{\mathrm{op}})$ through $N(\mathsf{BM}^\otimes)$) a nonsymmetric infinity operad with inert transports the coordinate projections, and its restriction over the lists in $v$ is $\mathcal V^\otimes$. Let $g:\mathsf{Chain}_2^\otimes\to\mathsf{BM}^\otimes$ send $a_0,a_1,p$ to $v$, $q$ to $m$ and $a_2$ to $t$; every allowed block has an allowed output type. The map $\mathsf{BM}_{01}\to\mathsf{Ass}_1$ sending $a_0,p,a_1$ to $a_1$ and each operation to the unique operation of the same arity respects composition and identities because $\mathsf{Ass}_1$ has one operation of each arity, and it sends inert operators to inert operators. Composing the algebra $A:N(\mathsf{Ass}_1^\otimes)\to\mathcal V^\otimes$ with it gives an inert-preserving lift over $g|_{\mathsf{BM}_{01}}$ with values $(A,A,A)$: the regular bimodule, both actions being multiplication. The coherent left $A$-module $Q$ gives the lift over $g|_{\mathsf{BM}_{12}}$ with values $(A,Q,*)$, the terminal right factor being the trivial one. Both restrict to $A$ on $\mathsf{Ass}_1$, since $\mathsf{Ass}_1\to\mathsf{BM}_{01}\to\mathsf{Ass}_1$ is the identity. The relative restriction equivalence of [lem-coef-composable-bimodule-operad-segal] for $v=q$ and this $g$ (essential surjectivity) supplies an inert-preserving lift $F:N(\mathsf{Chain}_2^\otimes)\to\mathcal E^\otimes$ with a coherent equivalence $qF\simeq g$ and values $A,A,A,Q,*$ on $a_0,a_1,p,q,a_2$.

source.place: Construction 4.4.2.7 and Example 4.4.2.12; the relative restriction equivalence for Chain_2

proof.text: Let $W$ be the subcategory of $\mathsf{Chain}_2^\otimes$ on the words $a_1^kq$ ($k\geq0$) with the operators over interval maps $f:[m]\to[n]$ satisfying $f(0)=0$ and $f(m)=n$; an output $a_1$ then receives a block of $a_1$'s (possibly empty) and the last output receives a block $a_1^rq\to q$. These operators contain identities and are closed under composition (composites of endpoint-preserving interval maps are endpoint-preserving), so $W$ is a category, small and countable. For each word the unique operation $a_1^kq\to q$ of $\mathsf{Chain}_2$ (total contraction) gives an arrow $g(a_1^kq)=v^km\to m$ in $\mathsf{BM}^\otimes$; these form a natural transformation $\beta:g|_W\to\operatorname{const}(m)$, because both composite block substitutions are the unique operation of $\mathsf{BM}$ of that type. Compose the equivalence $qF|_W\simeq g|_W$ of step 1 with $\beta$ to get $\gamma:qF|_W\to\operatorname{const}(m)$. Now apply [lem-coef-infinity-pointwise-cocartesian-transport] to $q$ (an inner fibration between quasicategories with all cocartesian lifts, by step 1 and the intrinsic criterion of [lem-coef-cocartesian-straightening]), $K=N(W)$ in the conventions of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], $F|_W$ and $\gamma$. Since $\gamma$ ends at a constant diagram, its fibre $\mathcal F_G$ is $\operatorname{Fun}(N(W),\mathcal E_m)=\operatorname{Fun}(N(W),\mathcal M)$; the transported diagram is $X:N(W)\to\mathcal M$, with cocartesian vertex components, so $X(a_1^kq)$ is the transport of $F(a_1^kq)$ along total contraction. No colimit is taken.

source.place: Construction 4.4.2.7, restriction to the retained-middle-word category and total contraction

proof.text: Since $F$ is inert-preserving, its inert edges from $F(a_1^kq)$ to its letters are cocartesian over the coordinate projections; by the product decomposition of the fibre of $\mathcal E^\otimes$ over $v^km$ (step 1, Segal decomposition of [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category]) the object $F(a_1^kq)$ is the tuple $(A,\ldots,A,U_AQ)$ in $\mathcal V^k\times\mathcal M$, the last entry being the value of $F$ at $q$, whose underlying object is $U_AQ$. By [lem-coef-cocartesian-straightening] transport along the total contraction $v^km\to m$ is the iterated action functor $(v_1,\ldots,v_k,x)\mapsto v_1\otimes\cdots\otimes v_k\otimes x$, any parenthesization being related to any other by the specified tensor and action coherences. Hence $X(a_1^kq)\simeq A^{\otimes k}\otimes U_AQ$; for $k=0$ it is $U_AQ$.

source.place: Construction 4.2.2.6 (ordered tensor convention) and Construction 4.4.2.7 (word evaluation)

proof.text: Let $f=h:[k+2]\to[k+1]$, $h(0)=h(1)=0$, $h(j)=j-1$ for $2\leq j\leq k+2$. It is monotone with $h(0)=0$ and $h(k+2)=k+1$, so it is an arrow $\phi:a_1^kq\to a_1^{k+1}q$ of $W$. Its output blocks are: for $j=1$, inputs $h(0)+1,\ldots,h(1)$, which is empty, so the operation is the nullary $a_1$ operation; for $2\leq j\leq k+1$, the single input $j-1$, an $a_1$, with the identity; for $j=k+2$, the single input $k+1=q$, with the identity. (For $k=0$: $q\to a_1q$ with blocks $\emptyset\to a_1$ and $q\to q$.) Factor $F(\phi)$ as a cocartesian edge $F(a_1^kq)\to g(\phi)_!F(a_1^kq)$ over $g(\phi)$ followed by a map $\psi$ in the fibre over $v^{k+1}m$. By the product decomposition of step 1, $g(\phi)_!F(a_1^kq)=(\mathbf1,A,\ldots,A,U_AQ)$, the nullary block transporting to the tensor unit as in [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category], and $\psi$ has components the values of $F$ on the single block operations: on the nullary $a_1$ operation the unit $\eta_A:\mathbf1\to A$ of the algebra $A$ (this is what the unit of the algebra $A$ is in the operadic model), and identities elsewhere. By the composition clause of [lem-coef-infinity-pointwise-cocartesian-transport], the transport of $F(a_1^kq)$ along total contraction agrees with the transport of $g(\phi)_!F(a_1^kq)$ along total contraction, compatibly with the precomposition maps; so $X(\phi)$ is the transport of $\psi$, i.e. $\eta_A\otimes\operatorname{id}_{A^{\otimes k}\otimes U_AQ}$ precomposed with the unit equivalence $A^{\otimes k}\otimes U_AQ\simeq\mathbf1\otimes A^{\otimes k}\otimes U_AQ$ of step 3. This map lives in $\mathcal M$; $W$ has no prefix colour, so no external left action is involved, and no linearity or colimit is used or asserted.

title: Regular leading-unit evaluation on words
statement: Use the coherent-diagram conventions of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], monoidal infinity-categories of [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category], the operator category $\mathsf{Chain}_2^\otimes$ of [lem-coef-composable-bimodule-operad-segal], and cocartesian transport of [lem-coef-infinity-pointwise-cocartesian-transport]. Let $\mathcal V$ be a monoidal infinity-category acting coherently on an infinity-category $\mathcal M$, let $A\in\mathcal V$ be an associative unital algebra, and let $Q$ be a coherent left $A$-module in $\mathcal M$, with underlying object $U_AQ$. Encode the regular $(A,A)$-bimodule $A$ (both actions multiplication) and $Q$ by an inert-preserving operadic lift $F$ on $\mathsf{Chain}_2^\otimes$, with values $A,A,A,Q,*$ on $a_0,a_1,p,q,a_2$; the action-valued target sends $a_0,a_1,p$ to its tensor colour, $q$ to its acted-on colour, and $a_2$ to the terminal right colour. Concretely, its restriction to $\mathsf{BM}_{01}$ is the algebra $A$ composed with the map of planar operads $\mathsf{BM}_{01}\to\mathsf{Ass}_1$ sending $a_0,p,a_1$ to $a_1$ and each operation to the unique operation of the same arity. Let $W$ have objects $a_1^kq$ for $k\geq0$ and all block operators retaining the final $q$ and preserving both exterior endpoints; operators and their composition are those of $\mathsf{Chain}_2^\otimes$. Restricting $F$ to $W$ and transporting along total contraction defines a coherent diagram $X:N(W)\to\mathcal M$ with $X(a_1^kq)\simeq A^{\otimes k}\otimes U_AQ$. The arrow $a_1^kq\to a_1^{k+1}q$ whose opposite interval map is $h:[k+2]\to[k+1]$, $h(0)=h(1)=0$, $h(j)=j-1$ for $2\leq j\leq k+2$, evaluates to the leading-unit insertion $\eta_A\otimes\operatorname{id}$. This assertion is in $\mathcal M$ after forgetting any external left action, and no linearity of the leading-unit map is asserted. No colimits are assumed.
